scope: Environment coverage of the delivered evaluation seed data/evaluation/seed.json, read at its clock. Only the seven record kinds count, each on one date field. Due times are listed apart. Activity rows are not counted, because each repeats an act that a counted record already dates.
reproduce_note: Run it from the repository root. With --check it compares with the committed report.
date_rule: A timestamp counts on its calendar day in America/New_York after normalizing its UTC offset. A date-only field (payments[].pay_on) is a day in America/New_York. A missing or invalid date is excluded and listed.

provenance.note: Counts are of the counted rows. Every record is synthetic: Brindle models no real issuer or website, so there is no real source to collect or to anchor.

app_records.kinds: statements, transactions, payments, disputes, offers, points_entries

activity.reason: Each activity row repeats a write, an event or an effect that a counted record already dates.
